question: A Zener diode is designed to operate specifically in the reverse breakdown region. To achieve a sharp breakdown at low voltages, how does the doping concentration of a Zener diode compare to that of a conventional p-n junction diode?

options.A: It is heavily doped on both p and n sides.
options.B: It is lightly doped on both p and n sides.
options.C: It is heavily doped on the p-side and lightly on the n-side.
options.D: It has the same doping concentration as a rectifier diode.
